name: Cadeler A/S
tagline: A global leader in offshore wind installation, operations, and maintenance services
hero_kpi_rationale: Le nombre de vessels est le principal driver opérationnel et stratégique de Cadeler, déterminant directement sa capacité à gagner des contrats d'installation offshore et à étendre sa présence dans la maintenance. Le doublement de la flotte en 2025 est un signal fort de croissance structurelle.

kpis.explanation: Nombre total de vessels jack-up pour l'installation éolienne en mer.
kpis.signal: Fleet doubled in one year: operational capacity doubled.
kpis.description: In 2025, Cadeler increased from 5 to 10 vessels with deliveries of Wind Maker, Wind Pace, Wind Ally, Wind Mover and the acquisition of Wind Keeper.

kpis.explanation: Valeur totale des contrats fermes et options incluses déjà signés.
kpis.signal: Backlog at EUR 2.8B: strong financial visibility over multiple years.
kpis.description: The backlog reaches EUR 2.8B as of March 24, 2026, compared to EUR 2.3B at end 2024, supported by long-term contracts in installation and maintenance.

kpis.explanation: Revenu annuel généré par les activités d'installation et de maintenance.
kpis.signal: Growth of +149%: fleet expansion effect and strong vessel utilization.
kpis.description: Revenue increases from EUR 249M in 2024 to EUR 620M in 2025 driven by fleet expansion and strong vessel utilization.

kpis.explanation: Résultat opérationnel avant amortissement et dépréciation, ajusté des éléments non récurrents.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDA increased 3.4x: significant improvement in profitability.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA rises from EUR 126M in 2024 to EUR 425.4M in 2025, driven by scale effects and efficient cost management.

kpis.explanation: Pourcentage du chiffre d'affaires provenant des services de maintenance.
kpis.signal: 20% of revenue from O&M: strategic pivot towards recurring services.
kpis.description: In 2025, maintenance represents approximately one-fifth of total revenue, with the launch of Nexra, a platform dedicated to offshore wind after-sales services.

kpis.explanation: Valeur totale des actifs détenus par la société.
kpis.signal: Assets up 76%: significant investment in fleet expansion.
kpis.description: Total assets reach EUR 3.417B at end 2025, compared to EUR 1.7B in 2024, primarily due to vessels under construction.
